summary: Publish durable source-addressed offline web embed archives with all assets, four screenshot posters, provenance and SHA-256 checksums from the release pipeline.

replay.detail: Release packaging only; no graph, claim, storage or replay changes.

schema.detail: No daemon schema change. The new standalone embed archive has a versioned provenance manifest.

compatibility.detail: Existing native release layouts and installation entrypoints are unchanged. The embed archive is an additional release asset and source-addressed prerelease.

downtime.detail: No runtime or deployment change for installed daemons.

manual.detail: Existing installations require no action. Website consumers opt in by pinning a published embed version and its archive checksum.

recovery.detail: Revert the packaging change to stop future embed publication; preserve already published source-addressed releases for pinned consumers.
